opening.argument: The video promotes a crypto-arbitrage workflow built around moving Litecoin between Binance and 50Trades, exchanging it for USDT, and withdrawing the proceeds back to Binance. Its description presents the financial inducement plainly: “Pure profit is 7-9% per round taking into account the commission!” The speaker then instructs viewers that “we need to send LTC to this address,” making the offer actionable rather than merely theoretical. Although the speaker acknowledges that “the spread may vary” and tells viewers to verify profitability, those qualifications do not establish that the advertised returns are genuine, repeatable, or available to viewers. The claimed profit therefore remains an unverified promise tied to a capital-transfer and exchange process.
